description: npm registry facts about pnpm releases that the workflows pin with pnpm/action-setup. Recorded so tests can check the pin offline. pnpm's self-installer refuses releases its registry metadata marks as broken (ERR_PNPM_BROKEN_PNPM_RELEASE, logs/opus/setup-publish-failure.txt); on npm those releases carry a deprecation message. Refresh with the commands in "source" when changing the pin.
